name: branding-modular-s-symbol-white-on-violet
title: White modular S made of two mirrored rounded L-shapes beside a wide sans wordmark on violet
whatItIs: A flat violet field with a white symbol of two interlocking rounded L or S shapes with a cross-shaped gap and a wide round sans wordmark 'Sovrix'.
whatItMeans: Friendly and technical; rounded modular geometry feels dependable.
techniques: Build an initial from mirrored modules.
Leave a cross of negative space.
Pair with a wide round sans.
Present as white on flat colour.
